description: Run a named accessibility action of an element: one listed after actions= on its line or under "More actions on #n" in observe_app, by that name (e.g. Increment, Decrement, "Show Alternate UI", "Scroll Down", "Show Menu", Raise, Cancel, Confirm; case-insensitive). Use only names that are shown, for what a plain click cannot do. Requires a prior observe_app for this app in this session. Call observe_app afterwards to verify the result.

app.description: Target app: its name as listed by find_apps, its id (bundle id / executable name), or its absolute path.

element.description: Element number: the #number from the latest observe_app output for this app.

name.description: Action name as listed after actions= or under "More actions on", e.g. "Scroll Down", "Show Menu" (case-insensitive).

name: invoke_action
title: Perform accessibility action
